question: Tax is 0% on the first €10,000, 20% up to €50,000 and 40% above. On €60,000, what percentage goes in tax?
move: A top tax rate applies to the top slice, not to everything.
ask: Have I ever turned down a raise or extra work fearing a higher tax band would take it all?
trap: 40%, the rate charged on the top slice of income.
hint: Tax each band separately, then divide the total by the income.
reference: Mankiw, Principles of Economics, 9th edition, Cengage, 2020
